tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version numbering scheme

The project's current recorded decision is to use Semantic Versioning (SemVer) for version numbers, because it is clearer about what consumers of the project expect.
EOF
cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md
